global.name: Global Application
global.desc: Global application-wide hotkeys active across all showcase views

preview.name: Component Sandbox
preview.desc: Hotkeys scoped specifically to the interactive sandbox canvas

search.name: Global Command Search
search.desc: Opens the spotlight-style command and component search palette.

navBack.name: Navigate Back
navBack.desc: Returns to previously visited living showcase documentation page.

navForward.name: Navigate Forward
navForward.desc: Navigates forward in the showcase page navigation history stack.

toggleSidebar.name: Toggle Sidebar
toggleSidebar.desc: Collapses or expands the primary showcase component navigation sidebar.

zoomIn.name: Zoom In UI
zoomIn.desc: Increases global UI scale density step with on-screen OSD feedback.

zoomOut.name: Zoom Out UI
zoomOut.desc: Decreases global UI scale density step with on-screen OSD feedback.

zoomReset.name: Reset UI Zoom
zoomReset.desc: Restores display scaling factor to default 100% (1.0x).

toggleTelemetry.name: Toggle Performance Telemetry HUD
toggleTelemetry.desc: Toggles floating real-time 60fps frame rate, render time, and heap memory monitor.

toggleTheme.name: Cycle Theme Mode
toggleTheme.desc: Cycles interface color appearance between Light, Dark, and System modes.

copySelection.name: Copy Active Selection
copySelection.desc: Copies currently highlighted code block snippet or text selection to OS clipboard.

codeBlock.embeddedDesc: Drop the card chrome and header for inline embedding
codeBlock.monochromeDesc: Monochrome fallback using the same layout
codeBlock.multiFileDesc: Pass a files array to render a tabbed group. Each tab carries its own language, and the copy button always targets the active file.

codeBlock.wrapDesc: Soft-wrap long lines instead of horizontal scroll

genericDataTable.overviewDesc: Click column headers to sort ascending and descending.

pipelineView.overviewDesc: A high-performance execution inspector assembling job tracking, vertical step timelines, and virtualized auto-scrolling log consoles. All subcomponents can also be consumed independently.

queryBuilder.overviewDesc: Add rules and nested groups dynamically to construct complex query predicates.
